items.rationale: Westlands, Karen, Bamburi and Kondele say Open, so the count is 4.
"<>Open" counts every cell that is not Open: two Closed and one Renovation, which is 3. It is also the 7 rows minus the 4 Open rows.
COUNTIF counts matches. With no matches the count is 0. #N/A belongs to XLOOKUP when nothing is found.
COUNTIF returns how many rows match. SUMIF adds the values of the matching rows (how much), AVERAGE does not filter, and IF tests a single cell.
